basic_details.job_title: JIPMER Project Technical Support III (Endocrinology) Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online
basic_details.short_information: The Department of Endocrinology at the Jawaharlal Institute of Postgraduate Medical Education and Research (JIPMER), Puducherry, is filling one Project Technical Support-III post on contract in the ICMR-funded project "NHFF-NET". The consolidated pay is Rs.33,600 per month, with an initial appointment of 6 months. Applications go by email to [email protected] and must be sent by 5.00 PM on 5 December 2026. Essential qualification: a Life Sciences graduate with three years of relevant experience, OR a Master's degree in Life Sciences, OR B.Sc. MLT with more than three years of experience.

important_dates.interview_date: Afternoon; timing to be announced after the written exam results

how_to_apply: Fill in the application form attached to the notice.
Attach your CV and supporting documents, scanned together in one PDF. A CV alone, without the prescribed form and certificates, will be rejected.
Email the file to [email protected] and write the name of the post applied for in the subject line.
Send the complete application by 5.00 PM on 5 December 2026.
If applying for two or more different posts, fill a separate form for each post and send each with its enclosures in a separate email.

important_instructions: No TA/DA will be paid for attending the interview. Incomplete applications, those not in the prescribed format and those not fulfilling the essential criteria are likely to be summarily rejected. Wrong or false information, or canvassing of any kind, leads to disqualification, or termination if detected after engagement. The notice says those appearing for the written exam without prior online registration will not be entertained.

content_sections.heading: JIPMER Project Technical Support-III at a Glance
content_sections.text: The official notification does not specify the application fee.

rows.details: Jawaharlal Institute of Postgraduate Medical Education and Research (JIPMER), Puducherry
"NHFF-NET: Developing a Multi-Centric National Hip Fragility Fracture Network with an Integrated Biobank Facility for Risk Prediction, Management, Validation and Improved Outcome"
ICMR – Centre for Advanced Research (CAR) Grant
Initial appointment for 6 months, with extension based on performance
Maximum 35 years (as on last date of receipt of applications)

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: The notice gives one essential qualification line with three alternatives for the single post: Graduate in Life Sciences with three years of relevant experience; OR Master's degree in Life Sciences from a recognized university; OR B.Sc. MLT with more than three years of experience. Desirable: Experience in patient handling. Experience in sample collection and processing (phlebotomy). Hands-on expertise in molecular biology techniques, including DNA, RNA and protein isolation. The maximum age limit is 35 years, counted as on the last date of receipt of applications. The notice prints no age relaxation. Qualification and experience should be in a relevant discipline or field and in a reputed institution or organization, and experience should have been gained after acquiring the essential qualification. The notice also says qualification, experience, other terms and conditions may be relaxed or altered at the discretion of the Principal Investigator.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The remuneration is Rs.33600/- per month (consolidated). The notice says the consolidated salary may vary from time to time and that no other allowance or facilities beyond it will be extended. The initial appointment is for 6 months, with extension based on performance. The notice also says the appointment is temporary for the first six months from the date of appointment and may be extended annually, depending on the progress of the project.

content_sections.heading: JIPMER Project Technical Support-III Job Description
content_sections.text: Blood sample collection from study participants (hip fragility fracture patients and age-matched controls) at baseline and follow-up visits. Sample centrifugation, aliquoting, PBMC isolation, storage (–80 °C / liquid nitrogen) and shipment of biospecimens from time to time to ILBS New Delhi and PGIMER, Chandigarh. Assisting in baseline and follow-up clinical, functional and quality-of-life assessments (3, 6, 12 months and annually). Project coordination with other NHFF-NET centres, including the coordinating centre (PGIMER, Chandigarh). To explain procedure and collect consent from subjects. Data entry on the NHFF-NET electronic data capture platform and compilation. Accomplish all the work as and when assigned towards project activities.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for JIPMER Project Technical Support-III
content_sections.text: Fill in the application form attached to the notice. Attach your CV and supporting documents, scanned together in one PDF. A CV alone, without the prescribed form and certificates, will be rejected. Name the PDF file "Candidate name_Post-name_year_application". Email the file to [email protected] and write the name of the post applied for in the subject line. Send the complete application by 5.00 PM on 5 December 2026. If applying for two or more different posts, fill a separate form for each post and send each with its enclosures in a separate email. A valid email ID and mobile number are compulsory. Applications not in the prescribed format will not be processed or accepted.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: Applicants are shortlisted on the details in the application, the CV and the documentary proof. The list of eligible candidates will also be displayed on the JIPMER website. The final selection is based on CV, application, and written test/interview. After evaluation of the application form, the process is a written test and then an interview. Only shortlisted candidates will be called for a written test and/or interview, and the Project Investigator's decision is final. The written test and interview cover core lab techniques (sample collection/processing, basic hematology, Immunology, Molecular biology or cell biology biochemistry, microbiology, ELISA/PCR basics) and GCLP compliance (quality control, biosafety, documentation, and data handling). Interviews may be held in person or by videoconference, at the discretion of the Principal Investigator. For a videoconference, each candidate must arrange a suitable device (computer, laptop or mobile) with audio and camera, and an adequate internet connection. Interview timing will be announced after the written exam results.
